vector_evidence.scope: Conditional VLOAD/VSTORE row access and path occupancy under checked routing and arbitration exclusions.
limitations: Logical MREG reservations and same-cycle visibility remain inherited.
Runtime addresses must be aligned, in range, nonwrapping, and collision free.
This is not an unbounded whole-RTL proof.

provenance.detail: The extraction tools, mutation tests, and full evidence ledger remain in Git history at this commit.

assumptions: Age zero is an accepted engine command.
Synchronous reset and idle flush precede launch; unknown-state propagation must establish known timing outputs. Unreset operand metadata is only inspected when valid.
Each MREG/VMEM request receives its corresponding valid response one cycle later.
No conflicting external port access or reset during transactions.
ScalarCore issueScalarLoad/issueScalarStore and decoded mem_cmd are explicit accepted-command cutpoints; hostStart stays low.
Scalar command/response connections follow the AtlasCore direct wiring; whole-frontend control is outside these scalar cones.
limitations: Finite control execution, not numerical arithmetic validation or unbounded proof.
Whole-system memory arbitration and frontend acceptance are separate obligations.
SV assertion regions are outside these output cones; engine overlap does not establish ScalarCore assertion legality. Existing compiler logical reservations remain enforced.
Scalar load/store address translation, byte masks and numerical payloads are outside valid-only extraction.
